opening.argument: The presentation promotes Wazaba as an investment opportunity by directing viewers to put Matic into the network, beginning with instructions to “Click here to connect your wallet” and to choose an investment amount with a minimum of 0.01 Maticch. It further presents the opportunity as capable of producing unlimited Matic and potentially very large referral income, expressly stating that viewers can “earn referral income by inviting friends to join.” The dashboard’s emphasis on team members, ranks, deposits, and level income reinforces that referral structure. Alongside these instructions, the material forecasts that Wazaba may equal or exceed Matic in value. Taken together, the promotional walkthrough urges immediate participation and directs cryptocurrency into the promoted network.
